# Retail Refunds Pocket Guide

The set of five: find_rebate_details, list_membership_plan_details, renew_refund, revoke_deposit, revoke_grievance.

Rule A — standing: the full five run only when the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) hold; unmet means refusal, and nothing checks them automatically.
Rule B — plan on file: the full five require the membership plan record pulled first, via list_membership_plan_details on the start date; the pull is one of the five, hence the opener. Missing -> ask for the start date, pull, retry.
Rule C — values: the full five take only in-policy argument values.
Rule D — consent: revoke_deposit and revoke_grievance additionally need the details recited and an explicit yes.

# Travel Manifests & Loans Policy

## Identity
cancel_invoice, create_manifest, renew_loan, split_mortgage, unfreeze_order, and view_loan_details require the customer's identity established beforehand. Identity is established by calling view_loan_details with the id — the call is itself governed, so it serves as the entry step. If unverified, collect the id, run the lookup, then return to the request.

## Confirmation
cancel_invoice, create_manifest, renew_loan, split_mortgage, and unfreeze_order proceed only after the details are presented and the customer gives an explicit yes.

## Unrestricted
suspend_quote and check_deposit_details carry no preconditions under this policy.

Banking grievances corner — short and sweet.

revoke_grievance is the heavyweight here. Before it runs: the caller must be verified (that's search_contract_details with the tracking number — no tracking number, ask for it, verify, retry), the details must be read back with an explicit yes, the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) must hold, the target record can't be frozen or closed, every value must sit inside policy limits, and it only touches the authenticated customer's own records.

adjust_invoice shares most of that — eligibility, frozen-record refusal, value limits, owner-only — but skips the identity step and the confirmation.

The lookups (check_loan_details, list_policy_details, check_device_details) are unrestricted.

Banking annuities desk:

- Eligibility (status/window/tier, system never checks): escalate_annuity, fetch_rider_details, renew_account, transfer_policy; unmet -> deny.
- ID first: fetch_rider_details, freeze_annuity, renew_account, transfer_policy — verify via get_consignment_details on the invoice number; unverified -> get invoice number, verify, retry.
- search_voucher_details, check_ticket_details, get_mortgage_details: unrestricted.

BANKING SETTLEMENT ARTICLES

Art. 1 (Assent). register_quote, settle_contract, settle_loan, and suspend_reservation shall follow only upon recital of the particulars and the customer's explicit affirmative.

Art. 2 (Qualification). settle_contract, settle_loan, and suspend_reservation lie open only where the qualifying conditions of status, temporal window, and tier obtain; the platform conducts no examination, and their failure mandates refusal.

Art. 3 (Dormancy). register_quote, settle_contract, settle_loan, and suspend_reservation shall be refused where the target record stands frozen or terminal.

Art. 4 (Limits upon Values). register_quote, settle_loan, and suspend_reservation admit only argument values within the limits fixed by policy.

Art. 5 (Antecedent Voucher). register_quote, settle_loan, and suspend_reservation presuppose prior production of the voucher record by check_voucher_details upon the case number; in default, obtain the case number, produce, and resume.

Art. 6 (Identification). register_quote, settle_contract, and settle_loan shall not proceed until identity stands verified through fetch_grievance_details upon the tier; in default, obtain the tier, verify, and resume.

Art. 7 (Residue). find_reservation_details and find_device_details lie outside these Articles.

# 소매 대출·견적 데스크 규정

쓰기 작업 4종: 견적 조정(adjust_quote), 대출 종결(close_loan), 대출 갱신(renew_loan), 티켓 해동(unfreeze_ticket). 조회 4종(check_order_details, get_contract_details, check_voucher_details, list_loan_details)은 무제한.

## 인자 한도
4종 전부, 전달 값은 정책 한도 내여야 하며 초과 시 거절. 시스템은 검사하지 않습니다.

## 변경 전 동의
4종 전부, 내역 제시 후 명시적 동의(예)를 받고서만 실행.

## 동결 기록
unfreeze_ticket 을 제외한 3종(adjust_quote, close_loan, renew_loan)은 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태면 거절.

# Telecom Tickets & Policies Manual

The governed six: cancel_ticket, lookup_mortgage_details, reject_rebate, retrieve_policy_details, update_device, view_claim_details. (view_contract_details is outside everything below.)

1. Standing — the six in full need the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier); unmet -> deny, system-unchecked.
2. Frozen targets — the six in full are refused on frozen or terminal records.
3. Identity — the six MINUS lookup_mortgage_details: verify first via lookup_mortgage_details on the membership (the verifier itself is the excluded one — it must stay callable to bootstrap). Unverified -> collect membership, verify, retry.
4. Ownership — the six MINUS lookup_mortgage_details stay on the authenticated customer's records.
5. Policy record first — the six MINUS view_claim_details: pull via retrieve_policy_details on the end date (in-set, hence an opener). Missing -> get end date, pull, retry.
6. Values — the six MINUS cancel_ticket take only in-policy argument values.
7. Consent — reject_rebate and update_device: recap details, explicit yes first.

# Telecom Deposits & Devices Policy

## Scope
Five operations are governed: approve_deposit, escalate_policy, extend_grievance, register_device, transfer_membership_plan. get_rebate_details is unrestricted.

## Prior order record
All five may run only after the order record has been fetched via search_order_details with the currency. If missing, collect the currency, fetch, then resume.

## Frozen records
All five are refused when the target record is frozen or terminal.

## Argument limits
All except register_device accept only values within policy limits; refuse anything outside. The backend performs no validation.

## Eligibility
All except extend_grievance require the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier); refuse when unmet — the system does not check these.

## Ownership
All except transfer_membership_plan apply solely to the authenticated customer's records.

Telecom write-ops briefing — six tools, same backbone.

The six writes here are cancel_device, cancel_endorsement, downgrade_deposit, merge_invoice, revoke_refund, and update_mortgage. Every one of them: takes only values inside policy limits (nothing downstream validates, so over the line = refuse), runs only when the eligibility conditions — status, time window, tier — actually hold, and fires only after you've read the details back and heard an explicit yes.

Ownership is the one place they differ: all of them except update_mortgage are limited to the authenticated customer's own records.

The two lookups, find_refund_details and list_endorsement_details, have no strings attached.

Travel annuities desk:

- ID first: close_subscription, reinstate_annuity, renew_invoice — verify via retrieve_deposit_details on the start date; unverified -> get start date, verify, retry.
- Frozen/terminal target -> deny: close_subscription, get_loan_details, reinstate_annuity, renew_invoice.
- list_device_details, get_claim_details: unrestricted.
